task: Deepen flagship open-tennis-robots: e-stop reset at the machine (quality audit 2026-11-08's last open safety gap)

doc_friction.issue: Said the feed interlock allows 5% wheel error; the firmware gate has been 3% held for 150 ms / 6 revolutions since 2026-11-11. Fixed here.
Still listed the feed interlock as untested although tests/feeder_sim.py drives main.py's gate (test_release_waits_while_the_gate_rechecks_the_wheels). Updated.

deviations.why: The BUILDABLE HERE list named another round of take-grid tuning on simulated wheels (eight-point grid, fit reading under 2 ms), which recent runs show has reached diminishing returns (14 vs 12 large misses, grid kept). The README's 2026-11-08 audit still listed an open safety gap (a remote CLEAR_ESTOP plus an e-stop release re-powered the motors) that matters more to a builder.
deviations.did: Built the reset-at-the-machine latch (relay K0 + RESET button with NO/NC contacts), its CAD logic model and check, BOM and manifest, simulated-feeder latch, runner and phone-page messages; left the take-grid items for a later run.
deviations.result: Audit gap closed in design and simulation; 255 Python tests and the CAD suite pass; flagships next: gains a person item to wire and check it on a build.
